screen.viltrumite_gens.title: Choose Your Viltrumite Level
message.viltrumite_gens.denied: You cannot change your genetics right now.
message.viltrumite_gens.reset: Genetics reset. Open the menu again to choose.
screen.viltrumite_gens.hint: Shift = 5 points per click. Negative points are weaknesses and give points back.
screen.viltrumite_gens.custom_desc: Spend your points freely and build a body of your own.
level.viltrumite_gens.soldier.desc: An ordinary soldier of the Viltrumite Empire. The mod's normal strength.
level.viltrumite_gens.mark.desc: Mark Grayson's level. More health, durability and damage than a soldier.
level.viltrumite_gens.conquest.desc: Builds on Mark: stronger stats, and your abilities hit harder and reach further.
level.viltrumite_gens.nolan.desc: Builds on Conquest: even higher stats, with ability power and area pushed further.
level.viltrumite_gens.thragg.desc: Builds on Nolan: the destructive force of your abilities grows as well.
level.viltrumite_gens.argall.desc: The peak of Viltrumite power. Abilities devastate an enormous area.
advancement.viltrumite_gens.root.title: Viltrumite Gens
advancement.viltrumite_gens.root.desc: Welcome to the Viltrum Empire. Try not to destroy the planet.
advancement.viltrumite_gens.chosen.title: Conquering Earth, Part 1
advancement.viltrumite_gens.chosen.desc: Choose your genetics. Dad would be proud.
advancement.viltrumite_gens.custom.title: Not Dad's Genes
advancement.viltrumite_gens.custom.desc: Build your own genetics. Nolan is concerned.

Recover from a wound and grow stronger.

advancement.viltrumite_gens.double.title: Twice the Viltrumite
